librehardwaremonitor.name: LibreHardwareMonitorLib
librehardwaremonitor.sha256Source: locally computed from the official nuget.org HTTPS package endpoint (no separate publisher SHA256 file offered outside NuGet's own package signing)
librehardwaremonitor.notes: executable (netstandard2.0) is loaded under PowerShell 7 (.NET); executableDesktop (net472) is loaded under Windows PowerShell 5.1 (.NET Framework) together with desktopDependencies, which are resolved by an AssemblyResolve handler in Telemetry.psm1 because powershell.exe has no binding redirects for them. Optional dependencies DiskInfoToolkit, RAMSPDToolkit-NDD and HidSharp are not downloaded; Computer.IsStorageEnabled, IsMemoryEnabled and IsControllerEnabled therefore stay false. Storage temperature is read from smartctl instead. Since 0.9.5 CPU temperature and motherboard (Super I/O) sensors need the separately installed PawnIO driver (https://pawnio.eu); this project never installs a driver and reports the missing driver instead.

pawnio.name: PawnIO (driver for CPU/motherboard sensors)
pawnio.sha256Source: InstallerSha256 of namazso.PawnIO 2.2.0 in the official winget-pkgs manifest (same installer for x64 and arm64); additionally the Authenticode signature must be valid before it is run
pawnio.license: Signed official edition by namazso - see https://pawnio.eu
pawnio.notes: Installed only after the user agrees at start (or with -InstallPawnIO). Silent switches '-install -silent' as declared by the publisher in winget-pkgs. Stays installed afterwards; removable via Windows Apps ('PawnIO'). Required by LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.5+ for CPU temperature and Super I/O (motherboard/VRM) sensors.
